_how: One entry per person, shown in this order on the About page. photo: a file in app/static/img/team/ (square jpg, about 400 px), or empty for initials. role, about and link are optional.

members.name: Steffan Wolter
members.about: Finishing a master's in computer science. Works on agentic AI systems that make guideline knowledge usable for language models.

members.name: Mahsa Forghani
members.about: Finishing a master's in computer science. Brings extensive experience in building knowledge graphs and connecting them to language models, and fine-tuned the model behind Lino with rules mined from the guideline knowledge graph.

members.name: Prof. Dr. Maria-Esther Vidal
members.role: Head of Scientific Data Management, TIB; Professor, Leibniz University Hannover; Member, L3S Research Center
members.about: Works on semantic data management, data integration, federated query processing and machine learning over knowledge graphs, with a focus on neuro-symbolic AI for interpretable and trustworthy systems, for example in medicine.

members.name: Dr. Disha Purohit
members.role: Postdoctoral Researcher, Scientific Data Management, TIB
members.about: Works on transparent AI on top of knowledge graphs and causality, in the TrustKG and P4-LUCAT projects.

members.name: Yashrajsinh Chudasama, M.Sc.
members.role: Research Assistant, Scientific Data Management, TIB; PhD candidate, Leibniz University Hannover
members.about: Works on explainable causal models over cognitive knowledge graphs, in the TrustKG and ImProVIT projects.
